description: Defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelTopComposeEmailButton class, a widget for rendering a 'Compose Email' button in a subpanel within SuiteCRM, including methods for generating the button HTML and handling access control.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopComposeEmailButton
classes.description: A widget class extending SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton, providing a 'Compose Email' button with dynamic behavior based on user permissions and context.

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Returns a unique widget ID, setting the button label from language strings.

methods.name: _get_form
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the compose email button, considering user permissions, email client, and bean properties.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the button if the user has edit access; otherwise returns empty.
